text:
1
1,2) Roll on the Slashers table. Reroll any slasher that you
have already defeated in the campaign. If all slashers have
been defeated, treat as no encounter.
3-6) Roll on the Witch Children table.

2
1-3) Roll on the Demonic Horror table.
4-6) Roll on the Beasts table.

3
1,2) Roll on the Lab Horror table.
3-5) Roll on the Undead table.
6) Roll on the Unique Vampire table.

4
1-4) Roll on the Possessed table.
5,6) Roll on the Living Dolls table.

6
1-3) Roll on the Unique Vampire table.
4-6) Roll on the Unique Zombie table. When rolling on
tables of Unique creatures, reroll any monster that was
already killed. If all unique monsters have been killed,
treat as no encounter.

en.title: Random encounter table (roll d6, then another d6)

zh-CN.title: 随机遭遇表（掷D6，再掷一次D6）
text:
1
1、2）掷杀手表。若掷出本战役中已经击败的杀手则重掷。若所有杀手都已击败，则视为没有遭遇。
3–6）掷女巫之子表。

3
1、2）掷实验室恐怖表。
3–5）掷不死生物表。

6
1–3）掷独特吸血鬼表。
4–6）掷独特僵尸表。掷独特生物表时，若结果是已经杀死的怪物则重掷。若所有独特怪物都已杀死，则视为没有遭遇。
